sample_unit: AI-generated patient education brochures (2 tools x 3 drugs)

links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid readability of AI-generated GLP-1 patient education brochures, ChatGPT vs Gemini
links.effect: Gemini had better readability scores than ChatGPT, which produced longer brochures with higher word counts. The abstract reports no numeric reading grade levels.
links.quote: ChatGPT generated longer brochures with higher word counts compared to Google Gemini, which had better readability scores.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability, similarity, and reliability of patient education materials generated by ChatGPT and Google Gemini without testing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
